summary: yoga-sutras corpus is missing II.5, II.48 and III.34 — absent from the acquired source
description:
corpus/hinduism/yoga-sutras-book-0{1..4} holds 192 chunks against a 195-sutra
canon. Missing: Book II sutra 5, Book II sutra 48, Book III sutra 34.

## This is a source defect, not a chunker bug

Both the numbered markers AND the body text are absent from the acquired raw:

  raw/hinduism/yoga-sutras-book-02.txt
    marker '5.'  followed by a capital:  0 hits   (4. and 6. each 1 hit)
    marker '48.' followed by a capital:  0 hits   (47. and 49. each 1 hit)
  raw/hinduism/yoga-sutras-book-03.txt
    marker '34.' followed by a capital:  0 hits   (33. and 35. each 1 hit)

And the content is not present unnumbered — grep for II.5's "impermanent" /
"not-self is permanent" and II.48's "pairs of opposites" returns nothing in
the raw.

Sequence check per book:
  I    51 chunks, sutras 1-51, no gaps
  II   53 chunks, sutras 1-55, missing 5 and 48
  III  54 chunks, sutras 1-55, missing 34
  IV   34 chunks, sutras 1-34, no gaps

## Provenance

  url        https://sacred-texts.com/hin/ysp/ysp04.htm  (book II)
  downloaded 2026-08-08T23:31:40Z
  sha256     61a07b18650beba796de6afb5877f9eb3b58ca5027a767c6d51488716803409a

Whether the live page also lacks them is UNVERIFIED — sacred-texts.com now
returns HTTP 403 to our fetcher, so re-acquisition may be blocked as well.
Someone should open the page in a browser and check before deciding the fix.

## Why nothing caught it

Node 01 vets the edition, not its completeness. Node 03 checks the fetch
succeeded. Node 08 scores readability of the chunks that exist. None of them
counts units against a canon. A failure-mode entry has been added to
docs/ingest/03-acquire.md; this ticket is the corpus fix.

## Options

- re-fetch and diff against the recorded sha256 (blocked by 403 today)
- patch the three sutras from another public-domain Johnston printing, keeping
  the chunk id scheme, and record the mixed provenance in the decision file
- source the whole text from a different edition — largest change, invalidates
  the 696 reviewed edges and 2,579 reviewed tags for these books
- ship as-is with the gap recorded in corpus metadata so citations do not
  imply completeness

Scope note: the 195-vs-192 discrepancy does not affect any judgement already
made. Every reviewed tag and edge refers to a chunk that exists and whose text
is correct.
